# Puragain Water — Southern California Home Water Filtration

> Puragain Water installs home water filtration and reverse osmosis systems that remove up to 99% of contaminants from tap water. Family-owned with 30+ years in the water industry, serving homeowners across Southern California with a free in-home water test, professional installation, and a lifetime service plan.

## Service Area
Based in Escondido, CA. We serve homeowners within ~50 miles of Escondido, across three regions:
- **San Diego County:** Escondido, San Marcos, Vista, Carlsbad, Oceanside, Encinitas, Poway, Rancho Bernardo, Del Mar, Solana Beach, Ramona, Fallbrook, San Diego, La Mesa, El Cajon, Santee, Lakeside, Chula Vista, National City, Spring Valley, Coronado
- **Inland Empire (SW Riverside County):** Temecula, Murrieta, Menifee, Lake Elsinore, Wildomar, Hemet, Perris
- **South Orange County:** San Clemente, San Juan Capistrano, Dana Point, Mission Viejo

Free in-home water testing throughout the service area. City-specific info: https://puragainwater.com/service-areas

## Products
- 5-Stage Reverse Osmosis System (from $26/month*) — removes lead, PFAS, chlorine, bacteria, and 99% of contaminants at your kitchen tap. https://puragainwater.com/products/reverse-osmosis
- 6-Stage Alkaline System (from $42/month*) — all reverse-osmosis benefits plus calcium, magnesium, and potassium restored, raising pH to 8.5–9.5. https://puragainwater.com/products/alkaline
- Whole House System (from $74/month*) — salt-free conditioning that protects plumbing, appliances, skin, and hair at every tap. https://puragainwater.com/products/whole-house

## Common Questions
- Is Southern California tap water hard? Yes — most of the region receives hard, chlorinated imported water; the Inland Empire has some of the hardest water and many homes on wells. Puragain systems remove hardness minerals, chlorine, and 99% of contaminants.
- How do I find out what's in my water? Book a free in-home water test; a technician tests on-site and shows you the results.
- How long does installation take? Typically 1–4 hours, handled by certified technicians.
